data.one_liner: A PageView widget that supports preloading pages before they are scrolled into view.
data.what_it_does: PreloadPageView allows developers to preload a specified number of pages before and after the current page. It provides a similar API to the official Flutter PageView, including builder methods and a dedicated controller.
use_when: You need to preload images or web requests before the user scrolls to adjacent pages in a PageView.
You want a drop-in alternative to Flutter's standard PageView with preloading capabilities.
avoid_when: You do not need to preload content or manage off-screen page lifecycles differently than standard Flutter widgets.
You require complex non-standard scroll physics not supported by the underlying implementation.
strengths: Drop-in replacement for the standard PageView widget.
Supports setting a custom number of preloaded pages using preloadPagesCount.
weaknesses: Relies on a custom implementation separate from the official Flutter SDK PageView.
Documentation is minimal and lacks advanced configuration examples.
